name: Public landing page explains BOW and protects private tools
covers: BOW logo displayed in header and hero
NCC and Kagini Help Desk contacts
admin and management tools hidden from public navigation
description: Verifies a public visitor can understand BOW, find application and partner calls to action, and cannot reach internal tools through public navigation.
steps: Confirm the BOW logo appears in the header and hero identity panel
Review the mission, vision, how it works, welfare tiers and Help Desk contact sections
Inspect the public navigation for internal management links
expected: The public page presents BOW information and clear application and partner calls to action; no admin, dashboard, tracker, upload, or Help Desk management link is shown.

name: Unauthenticated applicant submits a support application
description: Verifies a new applicant can submit without signing in and receive a durable reference connected to the private review workflow.
steps: Enter a name, phone, address, Help Desk and reason
expected: A BOW application reference is shown and the submission is available in the private applicant inbox and tracker.

name: Administrator uses the private control room and tracker
description: Verifies the authorized administrator can enter through the private route, import the tracker and remain in the control room during refresh.
steps: Open the private control room route with #control-room and sign in with the authorized administrator account
Select and import the General Registration Verification Tracker workbook
expected: Applications and Verification records remain searchable, accepted records with account IDs appear as active accounts, and the authorized administrator remains in the private control room.

name: Applicant and partner inbox responses persist
description: Verifies private staff can review public submissions and persist responses with their workflow status.
steps: Write a response and save it
expected: The response remains attached to its submission and the record can be marked Responded.

name: Partner applies without signing in on mobile
description: Verifies a partner can submit a complete expression of interest without authentication while incomplete submissions are rejected.
steps: Leave partner name empty and submit
expected: An incomplete submission is rejected; a complete partnership application is accepted and routed to the private partner inbox.
